[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Divisor game** [LC 1025 · Divisor Game](https://leetcode.com/problems/divisor-game/){difficulty="Easy"}

The table shows Alice wins exactly for even $n$. An even player can always subtract 1 and hand over an odd number; an odd number has only odd divisors, so the opponent must hand back an even number.
